citation.author: (anonymous)
citation.title: Analysis of the relationship between user immersion levels and the quality of UX design in Red Dead Redemption 2
citation.venue: Final Degree Project, Universitat Oberta de Catalunya (UOC)

provenance_weight: student FDP — lower scholarly weight; included for empirical UX/immersion data
thesis: Despite ~70 usability problems, RDR2 still engages players well (immersion above average, auditory presence exceptional); its strengths are not outshined by its UX problems.

concepts.gloss: expert review sorting issues into narrative/structural/mechanics; ~70 problems found
4 users x 7 tasks (~35 min); two tasks caused notable struggle
1-5 scale: sense of control, visual presence, auditory presence, interface awareness, real-world awareness
an immersion dimension; the degree to which the UI intrudes on presence
RDR2 engages well even with many usability problems; users want changes

readings.claim: RDR2's strengths are NOT outshined by its (numerous) usability problems.
RDR2 reliably immerses even immersion-resistant users (above average).
Usability struggles localize to specific tasks and corroborate the heuristic-evaluation problem set.
Auditory presence is RDR2's standout immersion strength.

game_elements.how_treated: heuristic 'mechanics' problems; sense-of-control dimension; two hard usability tasks

tensions: many usability problems coexist with strong immersion — a UX-quality vs immersion paradox the deck leaves unresolved

diss_hooks.hook: engagement-despite-usability-friction mirrors the BME VLE seed read (Wendt entry) — empirical corroboration of the design-conditions thesis
immersion dimensions (presence, interface awareness, sense of control) sit at A0/A1 of the actualization chain and map to Wendt transparency-vs-invisibility + Ihde embodiment/background relations
auditory presence as standout = high-leverage A0/A1 sound-design lever for RODA scene analysis (e.g., the Valentine bar-fight soundscape)
